SEBI monitoring Tata Sons governance amid leadership and listing discussions

Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) chairman has stated that the market regulator is monitoring developments at Tata Sons, particularly concerning governance, leadership changes, and potential listing plans. The focus is on ensuring adherence to regulatory norms during these transitions.
